posts.text: Is the company (or its clients for whom it manufactures) actually exporting anything to the US? The company claims it has “US FDA registered facilities”, in its Annual Report. The presentation has a slide titled Adherence to High Quality Standards which says, “legally allows products to be sold in the U.S. market”. image 940×243 75 KB But this food facility registration is a mandatory self-filed listing for sites making food or dietary supplements for the US.
